# Alerego

> Photographer and videographer at alerego.dev. Cosplay worlds and corporate narratives, shot as cinematic stills.

Alerego is a photography practice covering character-driven cosplay portraiture and brand, leadership, and event work. The public site is a portfolio with two main galleries.

## Site

- Home: https://alerego.dev/
- About: https://alerego.dev/about/
- Cosplay portfolio: https://alerego.dev/cosplay/
- Corporate portfolio: https://alerego.dev/corporate/
- Featured sets: https://alerego.dev/sets/
- Contact: mailto:contact@alerego.dev

Do not treat /admin as public content. Image sets are loaded from the public API at /api/public/sets.
